name: Church Membership
overview: Scripture presents church membership as a vital expression of the believer's commitment to the apostles' teaching, fellowship, prayer, and communal worship, as seen in Acts 2:42. The early church experienced growth through the Lord adding those who were saved, emphasizing the spiritual unity and mutual care within the body of Christ (Acts 2:47; Romans 12:4-5). Leaders are entrusted by the Holy Spirit to shepherd and protect the church, which Christ purchased with His blood, underscoring the sacred responsibility of church oversight and the importance of addressing the needs of all members (Acts 6:1; Acts 20:28). Thus, church membership involves active participation, mutual support, and submission to godly leadership within the unified body of Christ.
